description: This is a FastAPI route module defining endpoints for journal entries, including listing and creating journal entries for a demo user. It uses dependent authentication via headers and interacts with a database through SQLModel.

classes.name: JournalEntryModel
classes.description: Pydantic model for journal entries containing id and content fields.

classes.name: JournalCreateRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating journal entries, requiring content with length constraints.

methods.name: User get_demo_user(x_demo_user: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Demo-User"))
methods.description: Async function to retrieve a demo user based on the 'X-Demo-User' header, raising an error if the header is missing or user is not found.

methods.name: list_journal(user: User = Depends(get_demo_user))
methods.description: Endpoint handler to list journal entries for the authenticated demo user.

methods.name: create_journal(payload: JournalCreateRequest, user: User = Depends(get_demo_user))
methods.description: Endpoint handler to create a new journal entry for the authenticated demo user.

ctags.name: create_journal
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_journal(payload: JournalCreateRequest, user: User = Depends(get_demo_user)):$/

ctags.name: get_demo_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_demo_user(x_demo_user: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Demo-User")) -> User:$/
